_howTo: HOW TO ADD A PROJECT: copy one entry, give it a new id and fill in at least the English (en) text.
It then appears on the website AND in every CV (rebuilt automatically when you push). Other languages fall back to English until translated.
Images go in artifacts/portfolio/public/project-previews/. onCV:false keeps a project off the CV; onWebsite:false keeps it off the website.
cvRank (optional) orders the CV; projects without one go after the ranked ones, in this file's order. cvLinks label can be live, demo or source; use "launching" for not-yet-live.

ar.description: منصة تذاكر فعاليات مع تذاكر QR وتذاكر PDF قابلة للطباعة، وتطبيق للموظفين يفحص التذاكر عند البوابة حتى دون إنترنت.

입구에서 한 번만 스캔: 종이 티켓도, 줄 서기도, 위조도 없습니다.
